{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment to check for imbalance
print("Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
cross_tab_segment = pd.crosstab(df_filtered['channel'], df_filtered['customer_segment'])
print(cross_tab_segment)

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_age to check for imbalance
print("\nCross-tabulation of channel vs customer_age (binned into 5-year intervals):")
# Create age bins
df_filtered['age_group'] = pd.cut(df_filtered['customer_age'], bins=[0, 25, 35, 50, 100], labels=['18-25', '26-35', '36-50', '51+'])
cross_tab_age = pd.crosstab(df_filtered['channel'], df_filtered['age_group'])
print(cross_tab_age)

# Check if the distribution of segments and age groups differs between channels
print("\nProportion of each segment by channel:")
print(pd.crosstab(df_filtered['channel'], df_filtered['customer_segment'], normalize='index'))

print("\nProportion of each age group by channel:")
print(pd.crosstab(df_filtered['channel'], df_filtered['age_group'], normalize='index'))"}
